question: Can a development-selected probabilistic action-regret certificate preserve safety and paid decision value on later SAT solver portfolios after exact-equality transfer failed?

portable_representation.source: intersection of deterministic features provided by the declared acquisition step in all three scenarios
portable_representation.canonical_name: remove BASE prefix, remove non-alphanumeric characters, uppercase
portable_representation.collision_policy: fail closed on any within-scenario canonical-name collision
portable_representation.missingness: training-median imputation plus one missingness indicator per common feature
portable_representation.scaling: training mean and standard deviation, with zero-variance scale replaced by one

certificate_candidates.score: realized selected-action regret minus clipped predicted selected-action regret
certificate_candidates.quantile_rank: ceil((n_calibration+1)*(1-alpha)); infinity if rank exceeds n_calibration
certificate_candidates.upper_bound: max(0, predicted selected-action regret + calibration quantile)
certificate_candidates.deployment: use learned action iff upper bound <= epsilon, otherwise use proper-training global robust fallback

development_selection.subject: SAT16-MAIN official ten-fold aggregate only
development_selection.objective: minimum selective mean total excess; then catastrophic rate, p95, negative deployment coverage, model family, model parameters, alpha, epsilon fraction
development_selection.no_feasible_configuration: select the global objective minimum but emit development-gate failure

cost_and_oracle.solver_failure: PAR10 at each scenario's declared cutoff
cost_and_oracle.feature_failure: recorded finite acquisition cost, otherwise the scenario cutoff
cost_and_oracle.total_excess: acquisition cost + selected solver PAR10 - statewise virtual-best PAR10
cost_and_oracle.common_baseline: statewise virtual-best solver with zero acquisition cost

reported_certificate_semantics.guarantee: under exchangeability and a configuration fixed before the target scenario, P(deploy and selected-action regret > epsilon) <= alpha

validation_and_test_gate.selective_mean_overhead: at most 10 percent of the full-model gain over fallback
validation_and_test_gate.selective_catastrophic_rate: strictly lower than the development-selected full model
